text: Physics is a fundamental discipline that studies matter, energy and their interactions, with the exploration of natural laws at its core. It covers all scale phenomena from microscopic particles (such as quarks and photons) to the macroscopic universe (such as galaxies and black holes). As the foundation of natural science, physics deeply intersects with mathematics, chemistry, biology and other disciplines, giving rise to branches such as condensed matter physics, quantum physics and astrophysics, and providing theoretical support for application fields such as materials science, information technology and new energy. The major aims to cultivate research-oriented or applied talents with solid theoretical foundations in physics, experimental skills and scientific thinking.
